Include a certified translation for any documents that are in a foreign language.

Submit the documents by January 11, 2027, either by mail or in person after making an appointment by calling +43 1 4000-35590 (Monday to Friday, 8:00 - 15:30), and quote reference number MA35-9/2615448-2026.
If you cannot meet the deadline, apply for an extension in writing with a reason before January 11, 2027.
final.objection: You can apply in writing with a reason to extend the deadline before it expires.
final.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, your application will be rejected. After a rejection and once your current residence permit expires, you will no longer be staying legally in Austria.
